cues.zh: 這是QQ圖。

cues.en: So you see that the empirical data, the blue dots, are really consistent with the theoretical expectation for a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 經驗資料，也就是藍點，非常符合常態分布的理論預期。

cues.en: There's always a little bit of weird stuff happening at the boundaries that's related to just sampling variability.
cues.zh: 邊界總有些奇怪，與抽樣變異有關。

cues.en: But overall, this looks quite good.
cues.zh: 但整體很好。

cues.en: Okay, and then of course it's really easy in Python, you know, you might think, why do we go through all of these lines of code when we could have just run this one line of code?
cues.zh: Python當然也很簡單。你可能想，為什麼寫這麼多行，明明只需一行？

cues.en: Obviously in practice, you shouldn't go through all of these, you know, 50 lines of code or whatever.
cues.zh: 顯然，實務上不該寫全部大概五十行。

cues.en: In practice, for real data, you just run this one line of code and you get out the plot.
cues.zh: 對真實資料，直接執行這一行，就得到圖。

cues.en: But of course, you know, you're in this class because you want to learn how to do this stuff.
cues.zh: 但你來上課，就是為了學怎麼做。

cues.en: So therefore it's good to go through all of this code at least once to kind of take the mystery, take the magic out of what's happening here.
cues.zh: 所以至少一次，走過全部程式，消除背後的神祕、魔法感，很好。

cues.en: Okay, so then the last thing I want to do is compare this against, or run this again for this log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 最後，用對數常態分布再跑一次比較。

cues.en: You already see here, this is also like what I showed in the slides in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這裡已看得到，也像前一部投影片展示的。

cues.en: The empirical distribution no longer really matches this analytic Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 經驗分布不再符合解析高斯。

cues.en: And, let's see, oh yeah, this will be interesting.
cues.zh: 看看，這應該很有趣。

cues.en: So we can also plot the zSortData,
cues.zh: 也能畫zSortData，

cues.en: and also clearly looks different from the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 同樣明顯不同於常態分布。

cues.en: Okay, and then here is our QQ plot, and here is Python's QQ plot.
cues.zh: 這是我們的QQ圖，這是Python的。

cues.en: Again, pretty obvious that these differ.
cues.zh: 差異又很明顯。

cues.en: And so the conclusion is that these data are not normally distributed.
cues.zh: 所以結論，資料不是常態分布。

cues.en: Obviously in this case we knew that a priori, because we simulated the data, but in empirical data, you don't know that beforehand.
cues.zh: 這次事前就知道，因為是模擬資料，但經驗資料事前不會知道。
